reviews.reason: The printed numeral 7 begins this unit, which ends before XXVI. The supplied source matches the displayed text, retaining the asterisk before ለሰብእ while correctly excluding raised apparatus numbers 16–19. Note 19 explicitly supports the unusual people–such things–righteous order; construing righteous with people is defensible. The divine title supports “God of glory, the eternal King.” The first ከመዝ supports “such things,” and the second, prefixed with ወ, permits “and … in this way.” The final ወይቤ፡ የሀብዎሙ preserves explicit saying followed by giving; the English does not replace it with an unsupported promise formula. Safe as this individual verse, not as approval of the unresolved chapter.
reviews.footnote_changes: None. Marker [a] follows the complete sentence appropriately because its note addresses both the unusual word order and the final speech/giving construction.
